messages:
Samira Patel: Heads up  we're seeing a surge of low-quality NPS feedback entries from the new in-app survey. A bunch of accounts flagged as 'feedback_received' are driving unexpected drops in renewal score because we treat any negative feedback as -20.
Leo Grant: Did product change the survey? I pushed the new lightweight one last week to increase response rate. It has a "reason" free-text instead of categorical pain tags.
Ivy (CS Ops): That explains it. Our health mapping expects structured categories (e.g., 'feature_missing', 'billing_issue') to weight severity. Free-text negative responses default to severe.
Samira Patel: Two problems: 1) CRM ingestion maps raw feedback -> 'feedback_received' trigger without parsing, 2) playbook scoring treats 'feedback_received' as a hard penalty.
Leo Grant: Quick mitigation: stop scoring automation for feedback_received (pause rule) until we can parse text. Also add a temporary low-weight mapping for free-text feedback so it doesn't tank renewals.
Ivy (CS Ops): Agreed. Plan: A) deploy a short backfill that reclassifies recent free-text negatives into 'unspecified_negative' with weight -5, B) update churn scoring to only apply -20 for validated categories, C) add a micro NLP classifier to categorize free-text for future.
Samira Patel: For backfill, let's target feedback entries from the last 14 days. We should attach CSM notes on any account where we change the penalty. Acceptance: net renewal-risk should not increase more than 0.75% for the Enterprise cohort.
Leo Grant: SQL to find candidates:
```
SELECT f.account_id, f.response_text, f.created_at
FROM feedback_responses f
LEFT JOIN feedback_categories c ON c.feedback_id = f.id
WHERE f.created_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
  AND (c.category IS NULL OR c.category = '')
  AND LOWER(f.response_text) LIKE '%not%' -- quick heuristic for negative
;
```
Ivy (CS Ops): Good. Backfill runner will emit event: trigger_type='feedback_reclass_unspecified_negative', idempotency = md5(account_id || '-fb-reclass-202604'), throttle 25/s.
forms-bot: Created task forms/parse/backfill-202604 (id fb-2267).
Samira Patel: For scoring change, Leo can you open a PR to change mapping: feedback_received -> if category IN (validated) then -20 else if reclass = unspecified_negative then -5. A/B 10% on new signups for 7 days. Also include a CI sim to run historical 90-day impact.
Leo Grant: On it. I'll also prototype an inexpensive classifier (keyword + sentiment) to seed categories; we can improve with ML later. PR will include classifier script under infra/forms/parse.
Ivy (CS Ops): Acceptance checklist: 1) staging backfill shows predicted reduction in severe penalties, 2) CSM notes added to modified accounts, 3) CSV of modified accounts uploaded to /ops/cs/feedback-backfills/, 4) on_track delta < 0.75% for Enterprise.
Samira Patel: Timeline: staging backfill tonight, scoring PR tomorrow, A/B rollout next week. If staging looks good, schedule prod backfill in a low-volume window.
forms-bot: Staging backfill queued -> staging (run id bf-2267-stg). Throttle=25/s.
Leo Grant: Staging run results: scanned 1,120 feedbacks, reclassified 184 as unspecified_negative, 936 skipped (already categorized).
Ivy (CS Ops): Staging health delta: Enterprise on_track 1,042 -> 1,038 (net -4, within threshold), renewal-risk small increase but within acceptance. Uploaded CSV: s3://ops-cs/feedback-backfills/226789-staging.csv. CSM note template created at /playbooks/cs/feedback-reclass-note.
Samira Patel: Good. Proceed prod backfill in maintenance window Friday 02:00 UTC with same throttle and idempotency. Leo, make sure PR includes test that any change to feedback ingestion must include a scoring impact summary.
playbook-bot: Prod backfill scheduled for 2026-04-08T02:00:00Z (job id bf-2267-prod).
Leo Grant: Prod backfill completed: processed 3,412 feedbacks, reclassified 562, skipped 2,850. Generated 562 CSM notes and CSV at s3://ops-cs/feedback-backfills/226789-prod.csv.
Ivy (CS Ops): Prod health delta: Enterprise on_track 1,040 -> 1,032 (net -8, still within 0.75% threshold). Broadcast to #csm-team sent with CSV and FAQ.
Samira Patel: Next steps: 1) merge scoring PR and A/B rollout, 2) ship basic classifier and monitor classification precision for 14 days, 3) add pre-deploy checklist item: any change to feedback ingestion triggers scoring sim and CSM ops review.
Leo Grant: Will open PRs and include the heuristic classifier tests. Also tagging infra to add a monitoring alert if free-text uncategorized rate > 30% for a rolling 7-day window.
Ivy (CS Ops): I'll schedule a short enablement session for CSMs to explain the reclass rules and where to find the CSV. Closing loop here unless we see unexpected regressions.
forms-bot: Created checklist item: playbooks/ops/feedback-ingest-predeploy.
